items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Berty Randall, saxiphone player, Leroy Harris and myself were the Three Varieties.

ctx.x: Who was that little alto player? Harris? Was his name Harris?
Oh, Leroy Harris, who later joined Earl Hines' band. And --

items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mr. Safe; the interviewer identifies 'Mr. Safe' as LeRoy Harris, a saxophone player/treasurer in a band context, but the interviewee's response focuses on their own role as musical director and booking logistics without referencing Mr. Safe personally.

ctx.x: : Yeah, he's an alto saxophone player in the band. He became business manager and we always called LeRoy Harris -- another saxophone player that I used to -- he used to sing in the band, we called him Mr. Safe. So he was the treasurer.
